title: Foliation of area-minimizing hypersurfaces in asymptotically flat manifolds of higher dimension
summary: We prove the existence of foliations by area-minimizing hypersurfaces in asymptotically flat (AF) manifolds with arbitrary dimension and arbitrary ends. Also we provide behaviors of those hypersurfaces near the infinity of AF ends and demonstrate that the singular set of those area-minimizing hypersurfaces is outside AF ends (cf Theorem \ref{thm: foliation}).
